name: Service Checklist
author: Talos Community
description: 1 local file templates for service checklist.

templates.label: Service checklist
templates.content:
# ${1:service} checklist

- [ ] Unit file syntax checked
- [ ] Service starts after reboot
- [ ] Logs are readable
- [ ] Restart policy set
- [ ] Resource limits considered
- [ ] Backup and restore tested
- [ ] Rollback command documented
